title: Celestial Oracle
description: A blue-skinned mystic in a starry hooded robe and veil stands within a stone archway with red curtains, her face marked with golden symbols. She holds a glowing blue orb containing theatrical masks, crescent moons, and celestial icons while an orange beam of light shoots from her eye into a cosmic night sky filled with stars, nebulae, and floating ancient scrolls.
prompt: A mysterious blue-skinned female oracle wearing a dark blue starry hooded robe and face veil with golden markings, standing inside an ancient stone archway with red curtains and a hanging lantern. She holds a large glowing blue orb filled with comedy and tragedy masks, crescent moons, and esoteric symbols. An orange beam of light shoots from her eye into a vibrant cosmic background of stars, nebulae, and floating scrolls. Fantasy mystical style, rich colors, detailed cosmic atmosphere.
